core_obligations: Start from the integral domination and its affine open refinement.
Approximate the integral limit by finite finitely presented stages.
Descend opens and factorizations to a single stage and conclude.

proof_roadmap.step: Descent of the open refinement and of the factoring morphisms.

difficulty_reason: For an fppf covering {S_i -> S} of a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, the lemma produces a surjective finite finitely presented morphism S' -> S together with an open covering S' = union U'_alpha such that each U'_alpha -> S factors through some S_i -> S — the finite locally free domination powering the ph-topology comparison (card L16098 already collected uses this lemma by name). The retained proof is written: take the integral surjection Y -> X from the chapter's dominate-fppf-integral lemma (previously collected) with Y covered by affine opens V_j each mapping into S_{i(j)}; write Y = lim Y_lambda as a filtered limit of finite finitely presented X-schemes (Limits, lemma integral-limit-finite-and-finite-presentation); descend the opens V_j to opens of some Y_lambda (Limits, lemma descend-opens) and descend the factorization morphisms V_j -> S_{i(j)} for larger lambda (Limits, proposition characterize-locally-finite-presentation); S' = Y_lambda works. Retained author proof at lines 13767-13785.
